mapper.select: SELECT SETTING_KEY, SETTING_VALUE FROM APP_SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_KEY = #{settingKey}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO APP_SETTINGS t USING (SELECT #{settingKey} AS K, #{settingValue} AS V FROM DUAL) s ON (t.SETTING_KEY = s.K) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.SETTING_VALUE = s.V WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SETTING_KEY, SETTING_VALUE) VALUES (s.K, s.V)
